# The Vitest FORCE-FULL path set — `docs/decisions/ci-affected-tests.md` §2.1.
#
# A pull request whose diff touches a path matching any glob below runs the WHOLE
# Vitest suite, with the coverage gate, exactly as the merge queue does. Every
# entry is an input every test depends on that no test's import graph contains;
# the ADR's table gives the reason for each and must equal this list.
#
# It lives in ONE file because three things read it:
#   - `ci.yml`'s `changes` job, with bash `[[ $f == $glob ]]`, where `*` also spans
#     `/` — which can only over-match, the safe direction;
#   - `scripts/ci/measure-affected-tests.mjs`, with picomatch (`dot: true`);
#   - `tests/ci-changed-paths-gate.test.ts`, which executes the classifier against
#     one path per glob and asserts this list equals the ADR's table.
#
# One glob per line. A line starting with `#` is a comment.
package.json
**/package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
pnpm-workspace.yaml
tsconfig*.json
vitest.config.ts
vitest.collect.config.ts
tests/helpers/parallelDb.ts
tests/helpers/structuralGuardLane.ts
tests/helpers/vitestShardSequencer.ts
tests/helpers/vitestShardPlan.ts
tests/setup/**
tests/helpers/perWorkerDb.ts
tests/helpers/actEnvironment.ts
tests/helpers/inFlightProbe.ts
tests/helpers/inFlightWork.ts
tests/helpers/adminDb.ts
prisma/**
packages/**
.github/workflows/ci.yml
.github/actions/**
.github/ci/**
scripts/ci/measure-affected-tests.mjs
